title: Houthis Close In on Aden: Why the Red Sea Matters | Global Meridian
description_html:
Houthi fighters are advancing toward Aden, the temporary capital of Yemen's internationally recognised government, next to the Bab al-Mandeb strait. We explain the military picture, the humanitarian cost, why this route matters for world trade, energy and prices, and what you should do.

2:12 What should you do?
2:45 My Take
3:15 Outro

Sources
According to official reports and statements: Saudi-led coalition and Yemeni government statements, UN officials, shipping and insurance industry reporting.

This is an extract of our Daily Crux of 27 November 2026. Watch the full Daily Crux for the other stories and world headlines.
